สคีมา

Translation status: ภาษาไทย reader-locale proof. Term names and code fences follow the th-TH pack; supporting prose may still be English.

Declares an application-owned relational heading (experimental).

Aliases: relational heading

Syntax: สคีมา <Name> { คอลัมน์ <type> <name> ... }

Category#

declaration

Related#

  • คอลัมน์
  • ชนิด

Examples#

radix/corpus/schema/schema.fab (canonical · keyword)#

Declares an application-owned relational heading (experimental).

# =============================================================================
# สคีมา — Declares an application-owned relational heading (experimental)
# =============================================================================
#
# What this teaches:
#   • Relational headings — `สคีมา Name { ... }` names the columns an application reads from a database result.
#   • Declaration only — a สคีมา carries column metadata, not a runtime value, so a program that declares one still runs unchanged.
#
# Common mistakes:
#   • Giving a สคีมา methods or `เติมเต็ม` — a สคีมา is a heading, not a ชนิด; both are rejected at parse time.
#
# See also: คอลัมน์, ชนิด
# =============================================================================

# สคีมา — relational heading declaration
#
# GRAMMAR:
#   schemaDecl :← 'สคีมา' IDENTIFIER '{' (schemaColumn (NEWLINE schemaColumn)*)? '}'
#
# EXPECTED OUTPUT:
#   สคีมา declared

สคีมา Persona {
    column string ชื่อ
    column int aetas
}

main {
    print "schema declared"
}

Expected output:

schema declared
